doc_summary: `native_explosion_start(explosion, cancel)`, in `ServerLevel.explode` before the explosion runs: every server explosion, TNT, creepers, beds and anchors, fireballs, withers, end crystals and wind bursts. `explosion` (`NativeExplosionStart`) holds the dimension, centre, radius, fire, block interaction, damage type, and the source mob and its owner. Set `cancel` and nothing of it happens. Before `explosion_prime`, which a cancel skips. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:explosion_start@.
